works.body:
Hello, I've been a big fan of your art for awhile now and would love to see my OC in your style :) 

My Vtuber/OC's name is Eniko. She's always playing video games and hanging out with her pet red panda, Poi. Eniko is petite, standing at 4'11" (149.86cm) tall. He is mischievous, always getting into trouble, and has a childlike mentality. Poi, the red panda, has horns of the same color as Eniko's, and is calm and intelligent.

I am not particular about poses or scenery, so please use whatever comes to mind. I would like to use this piece on my Twitch and social pages, so I will leave a credit wherever it is posted).

Thank you for your consideration! (:

https://imgur.com/a/DqXsfaC

Hello I love your art work! I would like to get my VTuber model laying down or sleeping in a field similar to the attached images. If it is too complex to do feel free to take on creative liberty and do something you will enjoy doing! If possible I would like to have the background on a separate layer! 

I plan on posting the art on twitter and possibly using it on twitch and youtube! Thank you so much for your time <3

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1TWRK1L8rzmlVxMQn9PGcl2F5Ryg8ORfo?usp=sharing

Hello! You artwork is so lovely and I would love for you to draw my FF14 character, please! 
Can do you this pose (https://imgur.com/a/AjiMrUz) with her holding that pink flower? She is a white mage and she would have a blood lily in her hand. 
The composition and everything else I will leave to you!
Thank you!

https://imgur.com/a/6ETTZD2

Nice to meet you!
You draw very nice illustrations, so please let me make a request!

I'd like to request an illustration by Nanya Nia, a 2nd year student of Noripro.
I'd like you to draw her holding a lot of sweets in her hands.

I'm sorry for the trouble, but please help me!

https://noripro.jp/talent-mirutani/

Hello! I think your artwork is amazing and really pretty!
I would love for you to draw my vtubers alternate form/outfit. 

I'd like her hair streaks to be pink colored like the "Shamare" reference.
I also included a hairstyle reference, for the style and volume of the hair, so it doesn't look as flat and straight.

I'd also like both of her eyes to be the same shade of pink.

She is a mischievous ghost with tsundere tendencies, who's also very lazy.
Pose and composition is up to you!

Thank you for your consideration and I apologize if my request is a bit confusing.♡

https://drive.google.com/folderview?id=1G1uk5jLLz27Lgipb28y-GIPi2afPAT8Y

Hello, can you please draw my FFXIV character in your style?

She has horns instead of ears.  Her horns are covered in dark blue dragon scales.  These scales are also found in other places such as her cheeks, neck, arms, thighs, and tail (see reference material).

Please draw her in her yukata with a shy pose and expression.  A pose and expression similar to this sketch of Noelle would be good:
https://twitter.com/aribababanban/status/1374304845004378116

It is okay to draw her with or without her mask.  Please choose whatever you think would look best.  Maybe she is holding her mask in her hand instead of a rose?

I will leave the composition and other details up to you.  Thank you!

Yukata reference: https://imgur.com/a/xF9GRDw
Horns and scales reference: https://imgur.com/a/33nLzKq

Hello ! I realy love your drawings !!
I fell in love with your drawing here https://twitter.com/aribababanban/status/1427682023817191427 and I was wondering if you could draw my Vtuber character in a similar pose and expression ?
She could have a glowing star in her hands (I put a reference for the stars in my link ! ) ! 
She's a witch so the ambiance could be magic, night sky or whatever !

I would like to use it for my schedule, Twitch (no commercial) if you agree with that ! Could the star be in a separate file for maybe animate it later ? And same for the character if I want to put it on another background ?

Thank you so much ! 

References : https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1lp2lkkXjUnAvFVlAXSolJGDKo2W9mv6b?usp=sharing

Hello! I love your art and I would like to request my character working in a cute dessert cafe whether it be working behind the counter or serving drinks or desserts. Feel free to choose whatever cafe theme.

The pose and expression are up to you. She has a pink and white maid outfit with blue details and fluffy brown dog ears and wears rose gold circle glasses. In the back, there's a big pink bow and a dog tail.

This would be used for SNS / Twitter, schedule art, and Twitch panel art if that is okay with you.
A version without my name on it would be great as well.

Thank you so much.

https://sta.sh/21zvlmqpqiy7

Hello! I would like to request this character reading some sort of magical book, the pose and expression are up to you. Her pupils are white and she wears a high collared poncho and a hat with three pins on it (a fox pin, a bird pin, and a panda pin, the designs do not matter much). I am not an artist so I tried to add what I could to make the design more clear in case my drawing is not good enough. Thank you very much.

https://imgur.com/a/DasqNBr

Hello, nice to meet you. I love your paintings. I’m happy you opened requests. Can you please draw my original character in your style? His race type is similar to a gnome or dwarf, so he's very short. His character theme is tomato and plants. About his personality: he likes to drink tea, he’s carefree, and likes to be comfortable. He is a farmer and fisherman. His ears and hands are large.  

Character material: https://imgur.com/a/ju3kKZ0 
You can choose the expression and pose. Feel free to alter the outfit details.
Thank you very much!

https://imgur.com/a/ju3kKZ0

https://imgur.com/a/uL1YBJg

https://imgur.com/a/l9uvd8I

The first Link is an original character, a half-elf half-demon; the second Link is in human form. She is an office worker with very tired eyes, a big evil grin, and a disheveled look on her face. I would appreciate it if you could draw one or both of your choice in your style. Please take into account that both characters have darker skin tones.

Hey hey again!

I would like my VTuber Model (@KiguRoomie) to have their back slightly facing the camera's POV as he's working in an Audio booth (see reference).

Hi Tama!

I like your art and saw you drew Mugi's reference sheet so I was hoping you could make a reference sheet of my vtuber Glass!

I'd like to request a fully rendered forward facing full body, and a half rendered side and back (being fully rendered only if you're willing). If you could draw a couple of facial expressions that'd be awesome- some I was thinking of are smug, shocked, sad, and excited if possible. 

Overall he's very calm and cheery, he'll always try to put a smile on other peoples' face! He has a lean build so feel free to draw him a bit thin.

Reference can be found here: https://imgur.com/a/NdnrAeK
A few notes/simplifications: 
-please ignore the small triangle designs on the white half of his pants
-please disregard the eye scar, I think it's a little edgy for my character
-please keep his complexion tan/light brown

Thank you for your consideration!!

Hello Tama! 
I love your art very much! I would like to request a reference sheet of my vtuber Mugi! I would like to request a fully rendered forward facing full body, and a half rendered side and back (being fully rendered only if you're willing). please give special attention to her shoes, accessories, and also draw a couple of facial expressions if willing! (angry, flustered, sad, excited) if possible and not too much of a request, please also draw her snake-dragon form.
She is a energetic, mature, and outgoing dragon in training! She is very strong and athletic so please do not make her limbs too thin. If possible, please provide transparency for all art! Thank you so much for your consideration!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/15HZ_VOVA6yOCWBX-zdVE6tU9_uzp0ezc?usp=sharing
